title: Travel insurance for every type of trip
summary: Describes the trip types SafeTrip covers, including vacation, cruise, student, business and volunteer travel, and how to choose a plan.

assets.alt: Couple on a cruise ship deck

atoms.title: SafeTrip covers many types of trips
atoms.question: What types of trips does SafeTrip travel insurance cover?
atoms.text: SafeTrip provides travel insurance for trips of many types, whether a traveler is boarding a cruise ship, flying for a dream vacation, attending an important business meeting or something else. The page highlights vacation, cruise, student, business and global volunteering travel, and says SafeTrip may be able to protect other trip types as well.
questions: What kinds of trips can I insure with SafeTrip?

atoms.title: Vacation and cruise travel coverage
atoms.question: Does SafeTrip offer travel insurance for vacations and cruises?
atoms.text: SafeTrip offers plans for vacation travel, whether a road trip across the United States or an international journey to new places. For cruise travel, SafeTrip describes a cruise as a serious investment in fun and says travelers can board knowing SafeTrip has their back if anything goes awry with cruise holiday insurance.
questions: Can I get travel insurance for a cruise?

atoms.title: Student travel insurance
atoms.question: Is there travel insurance for students going abroad?
atoms.text: Many college students embark on once-in-a-lifetime trips for internships, cultural exchanges, semester abroad and more. SafeTrip suggests that students getting ready for such a journey consider travel and medical insurance for students traveling internationally.
questions: Do I need travel insurance for study abroad?
What insurance should a student buy for a semester abroad?

atoms.title: Business travel and global volunteering insurance
atoms.question: What travel insurance is available for business trips and volunteering abroad?
atoms.text: SafeTrip says that even as business relies on online communication, there is no substitute for face time with colleagues and clients, and it suggests protecting those trips with business travel insurance. For global volunteering, which it calls a transformational experience that can involve difficult travel, SafeTrip recommends international travel health insurance and trip protection.
questions: Does SafeTrip cover volunteer trips abroad?

atoms.title: How to choose the right SafeTrip plan
atoms.question: How do I choose the right travel insurance plan?
atoms.text: SafeTrip suggests three steps. 1) Consider your location: Travel Protection plans cover domestic trips within the United States, while International Travel Medical Plus and International Travel Medical plans can help with international travel. 2) Decide your coverage type: consider protection for travel issues, medical needs or both, and consider add-ons. 3) Get your quote by answering a few questions about the trip.
questions: How do I pick between SafeTrip plans?
What do I need to decide before getting a travel insurance quote?

atoms.title: SafeTrip excluded countries list
atoms.question: Are there countries that are not covered under a SafeTrip policy?
atoms.text: SafeTrip's trip types page points to a separate page with an up-to-date list of countries it does not cover. The page invites people with questions to contact its information and sales team.
questions: Which countries does SafeTrip not cover?
Where can I see restricted countries for travel insurance?

atoms.title: Reasons to buy travel insurance for any trip
atoms.question: Why buy travel insurance for any type of trip?
atoms.text: Travel insurance eases worry whether a person is traveling for fun, work, volunteering or another reason. SafeTrip lists four benefits: reimbursement for trip delays, cancellations and baggage loss; staff who can help find the right doctor; international travel medical coverage that can reimburse small or large medical costs; and 24/7 access to its in-house Emergency Response Center.
